changelog:
FABLE +
 — Home Assistant Integration, Presence AI, OpenWakeWord Engine Rewrite, microWakeWord Native Verification, Peer Sync, Music Control Surface, Tablet Settings, Crash Recovery

Home Assistant finally has its own place inside Ava. Connection Settings discovers local HA instances or signs in with URL and long-lived token. Lists full Assist pipeline collection, chooses preferred pipeline, adjusts language, conversation agent, STT, TTS, voice. Weather, media players, Quick Entities, Dawn cards, Simple Clock status, scene editing now search and select entities instead of copying IDs. Bluetooth scan mode and service-call permission aligned with HA. Light, scene, media actions sent directly through WebSocket. Camera Quick Entity requests real HLS stream from HA, same authenticated session for protected frames and artwork. Gesture zooming and free panning on camera tiles. Path: Settings → Connection → Home Assistant.

Bluetooth Presence AI: first complete presence path across rooted, Shizuku, and non-root devices. Device Admin lock permission enables local inference, dark-screen verification, automatic sleep return without flashing OS. On-device inference engine, no cloud, no internet needed. Multi-signal temporal reasoning: dynamic advertising cadence fingerprint per device, fuses RSSI movement, bonded connections, ambient radio, correlated silence. Cohort-silence correlation resets scan generation when several devices vanish together. Dark Wake Verification: reversible dark-screen radio transaction, pure-black low-brightness protection layer, briefly restores complete scan window to recapture rotated private addresses. Commits fully or rolls back safely. User touch always highest priority. Tiered self-healing: session rotation, liveness probing, scanner reconstruction, system recovery. Bluetooth/Wi-Fi shared radio path vetoes dangerous recovery. Time-bounded inference, never holds household indefinitely. Ava does not believe someone left merely because it heard nothing; it first proves it can still hear.

Longer voice answers no longer stop at ten seconds. Streaming TTS no longer ends on fixed ten-second countdown; plays through as long as new audio arrives, recovery only after genuine stop. Thanks @realroywalker #191.

C++ OpenWakeWord engine rewrite: 96-dimensional acoustic representation, not rigid waveform memorization. Native C++ reads ONNX graphs, reconstructs convolution/pooling/activation, turns complete-audio model into streaming engine. Retains completed layer state, advances only new sound. Removes ~86% repeated convolution work. Two streaming graphs offset by half step, scoring interval 80ms → 40ms. Shared representation for multiple wake words, lightweight classifier per phrase. Automatic fallback to complete ONNX path for incompatible models. Consecutive window required for detection, score must fall before rearming. Fixes first utterance swallowed by false cooldown, retunes speech lookback for quiet rooms. Light reset after conversation instead of deaf period. Sensitivity works with temporal confirmation, rearming, voice activity.

microWakeWord native regression verification: after streaming model fires, retrieves complete contiguous wake phrase from ring buffer, runs through Ava Pro custom C++ audio frontend, independent regression check. Follows active sensitivity, calibrated room for cold frontend state, short-phrase boundaries, partially filled window. Low-score rearm no longer mistaken for second detection requirement. Child and female voices no longer disproportionately filtered. 100 hours continuous sample validation completed. Stable option refined through native verification path.

Voice Stats shows wake engine processing headroom: average time, peak time, real-time limit. Turns red when device cannot keep up. Thanks @daydy16 #190.

Two wake words independent motion, transparency, color. Glow follows voice level, never invisible. Immediate preview.

Wake Word Library: complete online entry point. Search models, inspect author/source, download progress, install from curated catalog or community collection. Format and integrity checks, source/license attached. Curated and community boundaries clear. 100+ community models in separate library. Import ZIP, bare .onnx, or JSON+model. Auto-generates config from ONNX only. Batch imports report successes/failures separately. Path: Settings → Voice Configuration → Wake Word Library.

Peer synchronization: play, pause, resume, seek carry explicit new state across LAN. Late-joining or missed-update devices converge from later packets. Leading/following devices continuously calibrate displayed position. No freeze on different seconds after pause, no apart start on resume, no ignored seek. Stable peer becomes progress reference in multi-device groups. Leaving group removes stale track identity, artwork, progress together. Completes final Ava-to-Ava leg when upstream state briefly incomplete.

Music window becomes control surface: complete sidebar in detailed MA player. Inspect/reorder Up Next, search songs/albums/playlists, play playlist or add to queue, favorite current item. Speakers page manages groups and member volume. Sync controls auto-calibrate delay for this device and other Avas, remotely adjust another's 5-band EQ and lyric timing. Sleep timer, autoplay, track crossfade, queue clearing, multi-device window linking. Expanding/collapsing one player mirrors on paired device. Post-sync queue clearing optional. Sendspin stronger recovery around dead streams, track changes, seeks, pause/resume, queue clearing. Confirms audio genuinely stopped before skip. Brief silence no longer starts skip storm, stale progress cannot pull display behind heard audio.

Tablet Settings split layout: directory left, current page right. Full pane for expanded info, full-width for Software Update. MA login, statistics, handle sheets reorganized for pane. Settings reordered: Device Services follows Connection, Device Control and Device Logs at top. Common destinations earlier, Software Update, launcher controls, auto restart, display controls easier to locate. Disable split mode retains single-page navigation. Bottom handles, expanded explanations, entity search, Device Logs scroll correctly in active pane. Main service card and rotation recovery use lightweight centered loading ring. Path: Settings → Device Services.

Open household apps from HA: Minimal Launcher selected apps appear as dropdown entity. Automation opens chosen app, selects Ava Pro to return desktop, Close current app dismisses third-party interface. Never closes Ava itself, selector returns to Not selected. Path: Settings → Device Services → Minimal Launcher.

Crash recovery: brings Ava back after unexpected process exit. Separate watchdog for process-exists-but-interface-unresponsive. Records reason, attempts recovery; same failure twice in short window stops automatic restarts via fuse. Abnormal end records: latest 20 crashes, renderer deaths, interface stalls, user restarts, external exits, stall duration, stack trace. Not exposed remotely by default; appears after enabling Show and export logs. New installations enable by default, upgraded retain previous choice. Android 10+ requires Display over other apps. Path: Settings → Device Services → Restart & Exit / Device Logs.

More repairs: music over AOD no longer tears screensaver, preventing bright flash. Display sleep/lock/power tracked separately. Camera previews recover from blank frames. Pull-to-refresh only at genuine top, restores immersive display after status bar swipe. Browser first paint, split-pane loading, screensaver handoff use bounded waits. Notification animations, widgets, network, service listeners release old callbacks. ESPHome skips unknown messages, rejects oversized frames. Simple Clock 12-hour/background/AM/PM fixes. TTS animation no longer blocked by disabled Floating Subtitles overlay permission. New installations place Restart/Exit and Dark Mode at sidebar front.
